slices.behaviour: The eight findings of the third review: a window carrying anything unattributable states stay-shadow rather than go-live; a return from review declares itself with --findings, --unmet or --no-findings and is refused when it says nothing; four printed go-live instructions say two lines; a receipt voided by reopen is not a delivery; the routes report the window their rates came from; a repeated finding is pinned by test to the round that first raised it; a journal that refuses to be read is excluded and named rather than raised from inside another ticket's triage; criterion 1 is marked as amended and a sentence starts with a capital.
slices.failure_reason: AssertionError: 'go_live' != 'stay_shadow', on a window of ten clean tickets one of which carried an unattributable row; with six further failures, among them a return from review accepted with nothing declared, a voided receipt counted as a delivery, and verdict_routes reporting thirteen tickets for rates taken over ten
